title: fix(components): label a select nameField on the record heading's declared-pointer rung
body:
Fixes #13103
Clause-②: no

## What

`page:header`'s declared-pointer rung (`declaredTitle`) now reads the record through the same `withOptionLabels` copy the `titleFormat` rung already reads. A select `nameField` (or `displayNameField`) heads the record page with its option label, for example `Config change`, not its stored value `config_change`. The copy is computed once (`labelledData`) and both rungs read it, so the option lookup is not restated: `optionLabelFor` stays the one place this file maps an enum value to its label, and its doc comment now names both rungs.

Unchanged: a text `nameField` (it has no `options`, so `withOptionLabels` leaves its value as served), the rung order (explicit title, declared pointer, `titleFormat`, resolver, record-key net, placeholder floor), and the field-level-security reads (a masked field still arrives absent; the labelled copy only rewrites a top-level scalar the record carries).

## Tests

New `packages/components/src/__tests__/page-header-title.selectNameField-13103.test.tsx` renders the real `page:header`:

- (a) an object with `nameField: 'action'`, a select whose `config_change` option is labelled `Config change`: the H1 is `Config change`; the same with a `titleFormat` beside it (the pointer still answers first, with the label); the array form of `fields`.
- (b) CONTROLS: a value no option declares renders raw; a text `nameField` whose value equals another select field's option value is unchanged; the `titleFormat` rung still labels a select token.

Ablation (one-off, no permanent file): `objectstack/scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` swapped `recordDisplayValueAt(labelledData, declaredNameField(objSchema))` back to read `data` (anchor 1 to 0, blob `c4acc45de256` to `b4fadf1fe8ee`). The new file went `3 failed | 3 passed (6)`: the three label pins red (`Expected: "Config change"`, `Received: "config_change"`), the three controls green. Restore: blob after restore `c4acc45de256` equals the HEAD blob, `git diff HEAD` empty.

## Gates (on `74fdaee25e`)

- Closure build `pnpm --filter '@object-ui/components^...' build`: exit 0.
- `@object-ui/components` `type-check` (`tsc --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json`): exit 0; the test config's file list includes the new test.
- Targeted vitest: the four `page-header-title*` files, `4 passed (4)`, `42 passed (42)`; then every `packages/components` test file that names `page:header` or `layout/containers`, `36 passed (36)`, `493 passed (493)`.
- `eslint` on the two changed source files: exit 0, 0 errors (warnings are the file's existing `no-explicit-any` set; the new test's three match its sibling's helper).
- Pre-tsc battery, each exit 0: `check:phantom-deps`, `check:self-import`, `check:unreferenced-sources`, `check:doc-example-readers`, `check:handler-key-reads`, `check:side-effects-array`, `check:element-data-source-declaration`, `check:spec-symbols`, `check:action-forward-parity`, `check:designer-field-key-parity`, `check:icon-record-names`, `check:i18n-keys`, `check:i18n-drift`, `check:i18n-designer-parity`, `check:control-bytes`, `scripts/check-hand-rolled-comment-mask.mjs`, `scripts/check-changeset-fixed.mjs`, `scripts/check-changeset-presence.mjs`, `check:new-line-citations`.
- Declared to CI, not run locally: the full `packages/components` directory, and `packages/app-shell` tests that render `page:header` (record detail views).

## Acceptance notes

- `unifiedTitle` (the resolver rung, `getRecordDisplayName`) still reads the served record. It is reached only after the declared-pointer and `titleFormat` rungs both decline, so it is not the path this card measured; whether its type-aware derivation can ever pick a select field was not measured here. Noted, not changed (outside this card's ruling); carrier: none.
